findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

New evidence beyond the previous rulings: current-system descriptions still contradict this checkout. (1) `13-security-boundaries.md:271` says completed-run policies remain until process exit, but `apps/core/src/runtime/agent-spawn.ts:799` releases them in `finally`, and `apps/core/src/runtime/async-command-sandbox-policy.ts:20–24` deletes the registry entry. (2) `10-shared-domain.md:232,266` documents `start-gantry.sh` and a nohup fallback, and `11-deploy-scaling.md:291` repeats that fallback. However, `apps/core/src/infrastructure/service/manager.ts:37–41` selects launchd, systemd-user or background, and `:387–393` implements the background path with a detached Node process. These claims misdescribe cleanup and deployment behavior, leaving the required code verification incomplete. Correct all these current-guide descriptions and repeat the verification; the dated audits can remain historical.
